enemies.name: The Refraction Cannon
enemies.signature: Fires three counter-element volleys then a destruction volley. Launches one bullet per ordinary move on turns 1–15, two on 16–30, three on 31–45, four on 46–60, and five on 61 onward (maximum five). Bullets appear together in distinct spaces; larger volleys can overlap fields when separated lanes do not fit. The normal direct attack is not multiplied. Ordinary attacks alternate one hit and two different-element hits, escalating after each pair: 14, then 7+7, then 16, then 8+8, then 18, then 9+9, and so on. Final Blast and Purify pause this sequence. Both hits are shown in its intent. The first element follows its field; the second counters the first, or rotates through elemental partners when the first is Arcane. Bullets move two columns left; arrival is 12 Pierce. Covering disables a card. Radius-2 Manhattan diamond fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. On turns 4, 9, 14 and so on, it charges Final Blast, revealing its random element, and lays two Mind Mines on empty spaces. Cover or defuse the mines during your next turn: they detonate before Final Blast, each dealing 20 Fire if uncovered or destroying its cover. After the mines detonate, the next turn fires Final Blast: 40 damage the first time, then 50, 60 and +10 each later cycle, of the announced element, blockable by normal defenses anywhere on the grid. No bullets launch or act on that turn. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Kill or work around each moving field. Equipment is the only defense against a bullet that reaches you. Prepare matching Guard for the telegraphed escalating Final Blast; it can be defended normally.
